::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}
## Relations and functions
:::

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [Relation](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/chapters/relations.html#def-relation) on $A$ | $R \subseteq A \times A$; $a \mathrel{R} b$ means $(a, b) \in R$ |
| [Reflexive](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/chapters/relations.html#def-reflexive) | $a \mathrel{R} a$ for every $a \in A$ |
| [Symmetric](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/chapters/relations.html#def-symmetric-relation) | $a \mathrel{R} b \Rightarrow b \mathrel{R} a$ |
| [Transitive](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/chapters/relations.html#def-transitive) | $a \mathrel{R} b \land b \mathrel{R} c \Rightarrow a \mathrel{R} c$ |
| [Antisymmetric](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/chapters/relations.html#def-antisymmetric) | $a \mathrel{R} b \land b \mathrel{R} a \Rightarrow a = b$ |
| [Equivalence relation](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/chapters/relations.html#def-equivalence-relation) | reflexive, symmetric and transitive |
| [Equivalence class](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/chapters/relations.html#def-equivalence-class) | $[a] = \set{b \in A : b \sim a}$ |
| [Injective](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/chapters/relations.html#def-injective) $f : A \to B$ | $f(a_1) = f(a_2) \Rightarrow a_1 = a_2$ |
| [Surjective](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/chapters/relations.html#def-surjective) | for every $b \in B$ there is an $a \in A$ with $f(a) = b$ |
| [Bijective](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/chapters/relations.html#def-bijective) | injective and surjective |
| [Inverse](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/chapters/relations.html#def-inverse-function) of a bijection | $f^{-1} : B \to A$, $f^{-1}(b) = a \Leftrightarrow f(a) = b$ |
| [Floor](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/chapters/loop-invariants.html#def-floor) | $\floor{x}$: the largest integer $\le x$ |
